articles.title: Niners part owner agrees to purchase Seahawks
articles.summary: A group led by Niners limited partner Vinod Khosla has agreed to purchase the Seahawks, with sources telling ESPN the selling price will be a record $9.612 billion. The Khosla family will be required to divest its interest in the 49ers.

articles.title: No GPS tracker for Arnold, can work out for teams
articles.summary: Former Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold does not need to wear a GPS tracker as a condition of his release, a Florida judge ruled Friday, allowing him to continue to work out with NFL teams in an effort to get re-signed after being cut.

articles.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
articles.summary: NFL players are four times more likely than the general population to die of neurodegenerative diseases such as dementia and Parkinson's, according to a study released Wednesday.

articles.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
